quotes.name: Elijah Brown
quotes.quote: I flew on UNDOCKED Thursday night and went through a bunch of systems until the show's time ran out. I ended up even on credits. My standing is 3rd of 30, with 38.35 points and 0 credits, so it didn't seem to hurt me.
